/-- Informal hours as a share of formal plus informal hours. -/

  fun x => ellI x / (ellF x + ellI x)

Barraza26LaborComposition.interiorRegula.declaration_source:
/-- Local regular interior branch, including slackness and both sector FOCs. -/
def interiorRegularBranchCondition
    (V ellF ellI : ℝ → ℝ) (a d Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI : ℝ) : Prop :=
  HasDerivAt V d a ∧ 0 < V a ∧
    ∀ᶠ x in nhds a,
      0 < ellF x ∧ 0 < ellI x ∧ ellF x + ellI x < Hbar ∧
        V x * RF - psiF * (ellF x) ^ (1 / phiF) = 0 ∧
        V x * RI - psiI * (ellI x) ^ (1 / phiI) = 0

source_claim_use:Barraza26LaborCompositi.semantic_target:
∀ (V ellF ellI : ℝ → ℝ) (a d aLower Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI : ℝ),
  Barraza26LaborComposition.comparisonIndividualCondition a aLower RF RI →
    Barraza26LaborComposition.laborPreferencesCondition psiF psiI phiF phiI →
      Barraza26LaborComposition.interiorRegularBranchCondition V ellF ellI a d Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI →
        have sI : ℝ → ℝ := Barraza26LaborComposition.informalHoursShare ellF ellI;
        HasDerivAt sI (sI a * (1 - sI a) * (phiI - phiF) * d / V a) a ∧
          (Barraza26LaborComposition.localConcavityCondition d →
            (phiF < phiI → deriv sI a < 0) ∧ (phiI = phiF → deriv sI a = 0) ∧ (phiI < phiF → 0 < deriv sI a))
